items.what: A6 round 3: [L3] now cites thm-reals-ordered-field and cor-cauchy-reals-lub-complete (both added to deps) for the total order and completeness of the constructed reals, which the Archimedean theorem and the density lemma need as hypotheses. Earlier in A6 the title gained the countable-choice hypothesis claim 3 spends, and the closing Remark was corrected from "every basic box meets the antidiagonal in a single point" to the true statement that each antidiagonal point HAS such a box.
